args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Enhance the ExportButton component to store the user's last selected format in local storage or session storage. When the component mounts, it should first check for a previous format in storage and set it as the default, allowing the user's last selection to persist across sessions.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Enhance the ExportButton component to store the user's last selected format in local storage or session storage to remember user preferences across sessions, addressing the requester's need for a persistent format choice.
